{{nihongo|'''Takeo Wada'''|和田健雄|Wada Takeo|1882–1944|lead=yes}} was a Japanese mathematician at [[Kyoto University]] working in [[mathematical analysis|analysis]] and [[topology]]. He suggested the [[Lakes of Wada]] to [[Kunizo Yoneyama]], who wrote about them and named them after Wada.{{citation needed|date=March 2017}}
